claims.claim: Tesla CEO Elon Musk said the company will wind down Cybertruck production at Gigafactory Texas around the middle of next year to make room for increased Cybercab output.
claims.episode_span: Tesla CEO Elon Musk said the company will wind down Cybertruck production at Gigafactory Texas around the middle of next year to make room for increased Cybercab output.
claims.source_title: Tesla is ‘winding down’ production of the Cybertruck next year
claims.supporting_quote: In an X post on Friday, Tesla CEO Elon Musk said that the company will be "winding down" Cybertruck production at its Texas Gigafactory sometime around the middle of next year, "to make room for increased Cybercab production."

claims.claim: In the third quarter, Cybertruck deliveries fell to 4,323 from 12,364 in the second quarter.
claims.episode_span: In the third quarter, Cybertruck deliveries fell to 4,323 from 12,364 in the second quarter.
claims.source_title: Tesla to wind down Cybertruck production at Texas factory as it struggles to win appeal
claims.supporting_quote: Tesla does not officially disclose individual sales figures for the Cybertruck. Instead, the automaker groups it into an "Other Models" category, which accounted for just 8,295 deliveries in the third quarter, down from 12,364 deliveries in the second quarter.
